message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules (Standard Edition)** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or agree on another target). Points are earned when you finish a round by discarding all your cards and the other players’ remaining cards are counted as penalty points. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck works best with 4–8). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 25 of each color (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) numbered 0–9 plus two of each action card per color (Skip, Reverse, Draw Two), plus 4 Wild and 4 Wild Draw Four. | | **Setup** | Shuffle the deck. Deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile; flip the top card to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Players sit around the table. The first turn starts with the player to the dealer’s left and proceeds clockwise (unless a Reverse changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card from your hand if it matches the top discard card by **color**, **number**, or **symbol**. You may also play a Wild or Wild Draw Four at any time (subject to the “challenge” rule). | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and skips their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new active color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new active color; next player draws four cards and skips their turn (only playable if you have no matching color). | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you discard your second‑to‑last card, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to do so results in a penalty: the player who caught you must draw two cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards still held by the opponents: numbers count as face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring & Winning the Game** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. Play continues until someone reaches the agreed point threshold (commonly 500). | --- ### Common Variations | Variation | What It Changes | |-----------|-----------------| | **Stacking** | Some groups allow stacking of Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards (e.g., a Draw Two can be countered by another Draw Two). | | **No Challenge** | In casual play, the Wild Draw Four rule is relaxed: you can play it even if you have a matching color, but you risk being challenged. | | **House Rules** | Many families add house rules such as “draw until you can play,” “no calling UNO,” or “penalty for playing a Wild after a Wild.” | Feel free to adapt the rules to suit your group’s preferences!
